fact: Gabon's state infrastructure holder SPIN reports that on 10 November 2025 the Gabonese and Equatorial Guinean ministers inaugurated the physical and logical interconnection of the two national fibre backbones at Meyo-Kyé/Ebebeyin, with tests confirming stable traffic exchange between Bitam and Ebebeyin and between Libreville and Bata; the document names no regions or length for the Equatorial Guinean network and does not say Malabo is on it.
